items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I also had my first offer to go to England on my own and join the Alex Welsh Band and that was a tremendous band

ctx.x: In other words, before he closed downtown, he knew he was going to have an uptown place---
Yes, of course. And, I knew it too. But, I also had my first offer to go to England on my own and join the Alex Welsh Band and that was a tremendous band. And, I---
That actually came later but you had other offers -- you toured another part of Europe that time.
